name: Healthy Free Life (Katrina Sequenzia)
voice: Warm, plain, direct. Grace over guilt, never preachy. Short sentences. Sounds like a friend talking.
audience: Christian women, many over 50, working on weight, energy, cravings and eating God's way.
story: RN and health coach who has coached Christians since 2010. She was a Dr Pepper drinking, fast food eating yo-yo dieter until she learned to eat God's way.
